app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Good app
body:
I find this app quite helpful and unlike many other apps it’s easy to set up a variety of different goals so it will suit your need. 

I do wish it had an Apple Watch app so I could start timers directly from my watch, or that the widget was a bit better - currently you can only add one activity.
author: SKRAJO92
